Charizard 151: compare 006/165, 183/165 and 199/165

2026-11-05

Charizard 151 is not a unique card identifier. The English Scarlet & Violet—151 expansion includes several Charizard ex printings. Start with the official 151 checklist and the official Charizard ex 199/165 record before comparing values.

Match the collector number

Card AI's English MEW catalog returned these USD reference samples on November 5, 2026:

Card numberCatalog recordPublished USD samplePrice date
006/165Charizard ex - 006/165$8.922026-11-05
183/165Charizard ex - 183/165$36.482026-11-04
199/165Charizard ex - 199/165$295.982026-11-05

The samples belong to separate English card records. They are not the minimum and maximum price for one interchangeable Charizard card, and they do not establish a value for a Japanese copy. These examples do not specify a raw condition or existing slab grade.

Artwork, language and card state

Read the full printed number, compare the artwork, and confirm the language. A number above the printed denominator still belongs to a specific printing; the shared Charizard ex name does not remove that distinction.

For a raw copy, use the condition you can observe. For an existing slab, use the company and grade on its label. Card AI records those states separately; it does not predict an official grade from a photo or authenticate a copy.

Look up your copy in Card AI

Search Charizard with the MEW set code or collector number in the app. If you have the card in hand, use the Pokemon scanner and review its likely catalog candidates. Confirm the record, finish and language before opening its available published prices and history.

The table above is a dated snapshot. Use the price checker workflow to inspect the current record rather than treating an old example, a marketplace asking price or another printing's price as a sale guarantee. A missing reference remains missing.

For another expansion, see Mega Charizard X ex in Phantasmal Flames. For the same problem with Umbreon, see Moonbreon and other Evolving Skies printings. Confirmed cards can then be saved to your collection.
